kind: source-only diagnostic of Yggdrasil native causal-memory identifiability
hypothesis: The CKAD39 retrieval failure may be due to missing A/B-pure archival sources, observed-evidence nonidentifiability, or weak native archival forecasts. Freeze a separated ceiling analysis to distinguish these three causes without selecting or tuning a new learner.
scope: Read-only diagnostic on frozen native episode-memory representation. Exactly one existing NativeEpisodeExperience trains from authentic observed two-stage synthetic causal episodes. No new model, no selected policy, no source changes outside research/contrib/chatgpt/CKAD-40 and its new DEV-only GitHub workflow.
data: Use immutable CKAD39 synthetic generator, fixed action policy, 2 worlds per seed, unannounced stochastic A->B->A. Native receives only public views, actions, revealed transition and reward. True regime/phase and source-block purity are EVALUATOR-ONLY; never passed to native training or any deployable readout.

exact_protocol.source_model: NativeEpisodeExperience(repair=True), same source-only warm 48 / continuous stream semantics as CKAD39; default native context_forecast readout for baseline
exact_protocol.archival_eligibility: At forecast t, only already-built nonempty frozen archive blocks with stop <= current _context_start and range length >=8; one archive block is evaluator-labelled pure A or B only if all its already witnessed original phases belong to that regime. Mixed blocks excluded. No future event may enter a source or score.
exact_protocol.group_likelihood: For each A/B group, average archived-model likelihood for each of the last 16 already revealed transition+terminal consequences using log-sum-exp across frozen source models; compare group log-evidence values. Use no true phase to compute group likelihood or discriminate, but provenance grouping via evaluator labels is diagnostic-only oracle and is NOT a deployable classifier.
exact_protocol.coverage: Fraction of evaluator late_B and late_return_A episodes with at least one pure A and one pure B archival block available before the forecast.
exact_protocol.separability: Among covered late_B and late_return_A events, fraction where higher 16-event historical log-evidence identifies the evaluator's true current regime (ties count as incorrect). Require separate per-phase counts and no future outcomes.
exact_protocol.oracle_ceiling: For each covered event compute a phase-labelled oracle-only mixture forecast over the archived source blocks belonging to evaluator's actual current regime (uniform archived-model weights, terminal conditioned on already seen s2). Score transition and terminal before revealing y; record alongside native_stream, Beta full/rolling12/24/48/discount85/discount95 and prequential Hedge. This is intentionally an evaluator-only upper-bound diagnostic, not a usable policy.
exact_protocol.controls: Same genuinely observed events/actions and independent fully trained source-only conventional Beta+Hedge as CKAD39, without looking up CKAD39 DEV results for tuning. Log matched native source and cold integrity.

frozen_dev_screen.decision: If insufficient coverage -> ARCHIVE_COVERAGE_GAP; else if class discrimination insufficient -> IDENTIFICATION_GAP; else if phase-labelled oracle cannot beat native and strongest fitted controls by >=0.015 -> REPRESENTATION_GAP; else DIAGNOSTIC_POTENTIAL. Regardless of outcome: SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false; no held first use; no tuning/retuning on DEV cohort.
frozen_dev_screen.stop: One frozen DEV implementation and two-seed screen. Do not revisit seed scoring or adjust criteria after result.

qualification: Freeze prereg at first commit; implement pure diagnostic, negative tests, exact two-OS DEV workflow with actual action-consequence training; independent held unfamiliar-world qualification not authorized. Preserve source/checkpoint integrity and baseline.
